description_for_human: Ontology-driven six-modal semantic database with live data management
description_for_model: OntoDB is an ontology-driven semantic multi-modal database that unifies relational, graph, vector, time-series, spatial, and ontology data in a single engine. It features a 7-step atomic write pipeline, incremental OWL 2 RL reasoning, live data lifecycle management with exponential decay, kernel-level namespace isolation, and HNSW vector indexing. Use this plugin to query, insert, and manage data in OntoDB via OntoQL or SQL.

auth.instructions: Set the ONTODB_API_KEY environment variable with your API key.
